column1: ## The lane contract's declared failures, as data the history can compare (S-3, 2026-10-11).
## `# claims` is every claim of the lane suite (`lane::Claim::ALL`, in order) and `# rows` every
## row of `lane::EXPECTED_FAILURES` (its lane, claim, failure kind and repair, in order). The test
## `lane_contract_tests::the_expected_failures_are_this_list` holds both equal to the code, and
## `scripts/ci/check-expected-failures.ps1` holds `# rows` to the merge base: no lane gains a row
## for a claim the merge base's `# claims` already has. A claim new to the suite brings the rows of
## the lanes that do not keep it yet. Repairing a lane removes its row here and in the code. Since
## S-8 (2026-10-12) every lane keeps every claim, and `# rows` holds its header and nothing else.
